description: A City of Boulder open data layer of stolen bicycles reported to the Boulder Police Department. Contents: 9,880 reports when read, with city, district, report year and date, approximate address, report and call numbers, property status, property value, serial number and disposition. Coverage: Boulder, Colorado, report years 2015 to 2026; the layer was last modified on 28 September 2026. Format and access: an ArcGIS Hub dataset with a FeatureServer API and the usual downloads. Licence and cost: CC0 1.0, free. Caveats: points are randomly offset to hide the exact crime location, and only reported thefts are included. Useful as input for agent-based and hazard exposure studies of cycling security, such as parking location choice and the effect of theft on bike use. It relates to the Toronto and Berlin police bicycle theft records in the catalogue.
